newsitem.title: USA: Safety Components names Kaplan CFO.
newsitem.headline: Safety Components names Kaplan CFO.

text.p: Safety Components International Inc said Tuesday it had d Jeffrey Kaplan chief financial officer.
Kaplan replaces W. Hardy Myers, who was promoted to president of the company's North American automotive operations.
Kaplan has over 10 years of experience as CFO of other public companies, Safety Components said.
He was also named an executive vice president and a director, the company said.
Myers resigned as a director, it said.
Paul Sullivan, who had been president of North American automotive operations, was named president of Asian Pacific operations and will oversee the startup of those operations, the company said.
